Ana: Found a pigeon napping inside rack 3B. Not kidding. pic: https://i.imgur.com/PerCyNest.jpg
Theo: Percy the production pigeon has entered the chat. :pigeon:
Rina: Wait seriously? Could that mess with airflow or sensors?
DevOps-bot: Alert: rack-3B airflow nominal. No thermal spikes detected in the last 10 minutes.
Ana: Hes wedged between two trays and looks v calm. Heart = melted.
Theo: Is this an ops pet now or do we have to evict? :grimacing:
Rina: Please do not poke him. Also: tag facilities so they can do a gentle relocate.
Ana: @office-bot facilities?
office-bot: Request sent to facilities-team. Reminder: do not touch or feed wild animals.
Theo: I will stand guard and offer moral support (and a towel).
Rina: Im on camera duty. Uploading short clip. (video 7s)
Ana: He sneezed and then tucked his beak. Name suggestion: Percy.
Theo: Percy Approved. Someone make a slack emoji.
DevOps-bot: Note: server performance unaffected. Continuing monitoring.
Rina: Facilities queued for 15m. They said if Percy is chill we can let them handle it.
Ana: Update: Percy flapped out calmly when @facilities arrived. He paused on the windowsill like a tiny sysadmin and flew off. :wave:
Theo: Farewell Percy. May your migrations be bug-free.
Rina: 10/10 would rescue again. Also we should add a "do not feed" sign near rack doors.
office-bot: Logged suggestion: add wildlife signage to data center SOPs."
